context: Resolved Codex launch compatibility: npx automatic startup, bundled offline setup documented separately.
rationale: Legacy MCP does not expand plugin path placeholders; portable config forces plugin/data cwd. Preserving correct project store is more important than transparent bundled fallback. Proxy/server lifecycle changes would materially expand scope. Offline users can register an absolute bundled launcher and disable the contributed server. Reconsider when Codex resolves plugin paths while preserving session cwd.
summary: Chose npx with inherited project cwd over plugin-root cwd or a custom MCP roots proxy
